title: Some of you can play GTA 6 on November 18th
description: GTA 6 unlocks at midnight local time, country by country. Here's what you need to know before Nov 19.

lines.text: Some of you can play GTA 6 on November 18th. Here's when it unlocks for you.
lines.headline: PLAY IT NOV 18?

lines.text: It unlocks at midnight, local time, country by country.
lines.headline: MIDNIGHT LOCAL

lines.text: In the US, PlayStation unlocks November 18th at 9 PM Pacific. That's midnight Eastern.
lines.headline: 9PM PT / 12AM ET

lines.text: Preload is already live, and Rockstar says you need up to 212 gigs free.
lines.headline: 212 GB

lines.text: No PC. No online at launch. PS5 and Xbox Series only.
lines.headline: NO PC · NO ONLINE

lines.text: PC is reportedly coming early 2027, but Rockstar hasn't confirmed it.
Follow for confirmed GTA 6 news. No fake leaks.
lines.headline: FOLLOW FOR REAL NEWS
